protocol.selection: CSV measured indices only; row-wise sum before selection; all raw source series preserved
protocol.aggregation: median of three per-process measured medians in each on/off API/case group
protocol.classifier: classify+sort+finish cover the existing order pass including accumulated proof and trace effects; not isolated new overhead
protocol.transfer: Target/schedule copy+lookup primary excludes classification; schedule copy_ms includes complete literal schedule realization, not pure memcpy
protocol.inclusive: descriptive classification plus transfer/lookup subtotal; distinct from measured total_ms and does not explain all of its variation
